asks.ask: extrapolated onset 계산 및 표시 (접선: 450–800 DTG 최대점, 기준선: 500 중량)

data_code:
mask = (x >= 450) & (x <= 800)
if np.any(mask):
    i_local = np.argmax(y2[mask])
    indices = np.where(mask)[0]
    t_peak = x[indices[i_local]]
    y_peak = y1[indices[i_local]]
    slope = np.gradient(y1, x)[indices[i_local]]
    base_y = np.interp(500, x, y1)
    if slope != 0:
        onset_t = t_peak + (base_y - y_peak) / slope
    else:
        onset_t = t_peak
    marks.append({'type': 'vline', 'x': float(onset_t), 'text': f'Extrapolated Onset: {onset_t:.1f} °C'})
    marks.append({'type': 'hline', 'y': float(base_y), 'text': 'Baseline'})
